children: Money Arthur L, a Director, reported a sale of common stock at a weighted average price of $16.41 per share. The total sale amount reported was $820,500. After the transaction, Money Arthur L directly owns 54,545 shares and indirectly owns 12,498 shares. The shares sold were fully vested and the indirect holdings are held by the Money Family Trust dated November 19, 1981, revised August 26, 2016, of which the reporting person is trustee with voting and dispositive power.
